DoD contributions coordinated by DHAPP can also be viewed at the PEPFAR web site: https://www.state.gov/where-we-work-pepfar/. The DoD HIV/AIDS Prevention Program Directive, DoDD 6485.02E, can be found at https://www.esd.whs.mil/Directives/issuances/dodd/.
